summary: {coordinator} checks whether the contact posted in the building still reaches the right office.
realLife: Merced agreed to distribute its ADA notice to agency heads, publish it locally and keep posted contact information current.
gates: A county facility posts an accessibility notice with a named contact.
inGame: needs: the posting location and the current coordinator's contact details.

turns.what: The building manager posts the new contact.
turns.writesBack: The notice carries the current office number.

turns.what: The coordinator sends the correction to the web editor.
turns.pulledBy: The lobby copy is current but the county website lists the old number.
turns.writesBack: The online correction has an assigned owner.
